citationText: 6. Eadward Muybridge's pictures of a galloping horse photographed by a series of still cameras, each activated by a trip wire, to settle a bet as to whether or not the horse's hoofs actually left the ground as it ran, are often cited as Edison's inspiration for his own motion picture research.
